summary: Backend fully reachable on PUBLIC URL (https://oyun-loncasi.preview.emergentagent.com). All 13 pytest checks passed (root, login, bad-creds, /auth/me, stats, members, leaderboard, commanders, alliances). Admin login (admin/admin123) returns valid JWT with role=admin and must_change_password=true. Localhost:8001 also returns 200 on /api/. The user-reported 404 on /api/* could NOT be reproduced from this environment — most likely a client-side issue (stale APK build pointing to an old backend URL, service worker cache, offline/DNS problem, or corporate network blocking the preview domain). No backend code changes needed.
action_items: Ask the user to hard-refresh the web app / clear service worker (chrome://serviceworker-internals) and confirm REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in their built APK matches https://oyun-loncasi.preview.emergentagent.com.
For the APK: verify the release build was rebuilt AFTER REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was set — env vars are baked in at build time and old APKs will hit a stale URL and get 404.
Optionally add a startup log printing the resolved backend URL in the app to help diagnose future 'API unreachable' reports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py & auth.py routing looks correct: APIRouter(prefix='/api') on api_router and auth_router mounted via app.include_router(make_auth_router(db)) — all endpoints resolve under /api/*.
Seed admin flow appears idempotent (login works repeatedly with admin/admin123). must_change_password=true still set — confirm main agent has handled first-login flow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_public_endpoints.py (new — reusable regression suite via PUBLIC URL)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_public_endpoints.py hits the PUBLIC URL and covers root, auth (login/me/bad-creds), stats, members, leaderboard, commanders, alliances. All 13 passed on this run. If user still reports 404 from web/APK while these pass, the problem is client-side (build cache / service worker / stale APK bundle).
rca of the issue: Not a backend bug. /api/, /api/auth/login, /api/health-equivalents all return 200 via the public URL. Reproduction from server side: curl https://oyun-loncasi.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ -> 200 {message:'Oyun Loncası API',status:'ok'}. Admin login returns JWT + admin user. Mitigation: instruct user to rebuild the APK with the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, clear service-worker cache in the browser (DevTools -> Application -> Service Workers -> Unregister), and hard-reload. If corporate network, whitelist *.preview.emergentagent.com.
